senses.gloss:
रहणम् [रह्-ल्युट्] Desertion, quitting, separation; सहकारवृते
 समये सहका रहणस्य के न सस्मार पदम् Nalod. 2. 14.

रहस् n. [रह्-असुन् Uṇ. 4. 222]
—1 Solitude, privacy, loneliness, retirement, secrecy; अथ राजा दशरथः
 कदाचिद्रहसि स्थितः A. Rām. 2. 2. 1; रहसि रमते Māl. 2. 2;
 R. 3. 3, 15. 92; Pt. 1. 138.
—2 A deserted or lonely place, hiding-place.
—3 A secret, mystery; कथ्यतां न रहो यदि Bhāg. 9. 9. 19.
—4 Copulation, coition.
—5 Truth.
—6 Swiftness.
—7 A privity. ━ind. Secretly, clandestinely, privately, in private
 or secret; अतः परीक्ष्य कर्तव्यं विशेषात्संगतं रहः Ś. 5. 24;
 oft. in comp.; वृत्तं रहःप्रणयमप्रतिपद्यमाने 5. 23.

रहस्य a. [रहसि-भवः यत्]
—1 Secret, private, clandestine; रहस्यं च प्रकाशं च यद् वृत्तं
 तस्य धीमतः (कथय) Rām. 1. 2. 33; रोमाणि च रहस्यानि सर्वाण्येव
 विवर्जयेत् Ms. 4. 144.
—2 Mysterious.

रहस्य + .{@-स्यम्@}
—1 A secret (fig. also); स्वयं रहस्यभेदः कृतः V. 2.
—2 A mystic spell or incantation, the mystery (of a missile); सरहस्यानि
 जृम्भकास्त्राणि U. 1.
—3 The mystery or secret of conduct, mystery; रहस्यं साधूनामनुपधि
 विशुद्धं विजयते U. 2. 2; सरहस्यो धनुर्वेदः Bhāg. 1. 7. 44.
—4 A secret or esoteric teaching, a mystic doctrine; भक्तोऽसि मे सखा
 चेति रहस्यं ह्येतदुत्तमम् Bg. 4. 3; साङ्गोपाङ्गोपनिषदः सरहस्यः
 प्रदीयताम् Rām. 1. 55. 16.
—5 An Upaniṣad; चतुर्भ्यः सरहस्येभ्यो वेदेभ्यो ह्यधिकं यदा Mb. 1. 1. 272;
 Ms. 2. 165.

रहस्य + .{@-स्यम्@} ind. Secretly, privately; अनभिख्यातदोषस्तु रहस्यं
 व्रतमाचरेत् Y. 3. 300 (where it may be taken as an adj. also).
.━{@Comp.@}: रहस्याख्यायिन्, रहस्यत्रयम्, रहस्यभेदः, रहस्यविभेदः, रहस्यव्रतम्

रहस्य + -आख्यायिन् a. telling a secret; रहस्याख्यायीव स्वनसि मृदु
 कर्णान्तिकचरः Ś. 1. 23.

रहस्य + -त्रयम् the three categories of Rāmānuja school -ईश्वर, चित्
 and अचित् composing the universe.
रहस्य + -भेदः, -विभेदः disclosure of a secret or mystery.
रहस्य + -भेदः, -विभेदः disclosure of a secret or mystery.

रहस्य + -व्रतम्
—1 a secret vow or penance.
—2 the mystic science of obtaining command over magical weapons.

रहित p. p. [रह्-कर्मणि क्त]
—1 Quitted, left, abandoned, deserted.
—2 Separated from, free from, deprived or destitute of, without (with
 instr. or at the end of comp.); रहिते भिक्षुभिर्ग्रामे Y. 3. 59; गुणरहितः;
 सत्त्वरहितः &c.
—3 Lonely, solitary.

रहित + .{@-तम्@} Secrecy, privacy; नोपासितव्यौ रहिते कदाचित् Mb. 3. 234. 10.
.━{@Comp.@}: रहितासुर, रहितात्मन्
रहित + -असुर a. destitute of divinity.

रहित + -आत्मन् one without आत्मा (i. e. शून्यात्मा); शंसन्तु
 कृष्णपदवीं रहितात्मनां नः Bhāg. 10. 30. 9.

रहीभूत a. In privacy with; दृष्ट्वा दयितया सार्धं रहीभूतं
 दशाननम् Bk. 8. 55 ‘retired’.

—1 A minister.
—2 A spring.
—3 A ghost.
राहडी (In music) A kind of composition.
राहित्यम् Being without any thing, destitution; destituteness.

राहुः [रह्-उण् Uṇ. 1. 3]
—1 N. of a demon, son of Viprachitti and Siṃhikā and hence often called
 Saimhikeya; ग्रसते हि तमोपहं मुहुर्ननु राह्वाह्वमहर्पतिं
 तमः Śi. 16. 57; विधुरपि विधियोगाद् ग्रस्यते राहुणासौ H. [When
 the nectar, that was churned out of the ocean, was being served to the
 gods, Rāhu disguised himself and attempted to drink it along with them.
 But he was detected by the sun and the moon who informed Viṣṇu of the
 fraud. Viṣṇu, thereupon, severed his head from the body; but as he had
 tasted a little quantity of nectar the head became immortal, and is supposed
 to wreak its vengeance on the sun and moon at the time of conjunction
 and opposition; cf. Bh. 2. 34. In astronomy Rāhu is regarded, like Ketu,
 as one of the nine planets, or only as the ascending node of the moon.]
—2 An eclipse, or rather the moment of occultation.
—3 Abandoning.
—4 One who abandons.
—5 The regent of the south-west quarter.
